newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Gudang Garam says has $80 mln forex loans.
newsitem.headline: Gudang Garam says has $80 mln forex loans.

text.p: Indonesia's largest cigarette maker PT Gudang Garam has $80 million in unhedged foreign borrowings, the company's coporate secretary Heru Budiman said on Friday.
He said PT Gudang Garam had $5 million in outstanding loans while subsidiary PT Surya Pamenang had $75 million.
"(The loans) are completely open and unhedged," he said in answer to a question during a company briefing at an international capital market conference.
The rupiah has fallen to historic lows against the dollar and market-watchers have said companies which have unhedged foreign loans could be affected.

Earlier on Friday, Gudang Garam announced it had posted a first-half net profit of 410.65 billion rupiah, compared with 277.59 billion rupiah in the same 1996 period. Its first-half earnings per share was 213 rupiah against 144 rupiah
